verses.original: שְׁפַר֙ קֳדָ֣ם דָּרְיָ֔וֶשׁ וַהֲקִים֙ עַל־ מַלְכוּתָ֔א לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֖א מְאָ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֑ין דִּ֥י לֶהֱוֺ֖ן בְּכָל־ מַלְכוּתָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: šə·p̄ar qo·ḏām dā·rə·yā·weš wa·hă·qîm ‘al- mal·ḵū·ṯā la·’ă·ḥaš·dar·pə·nay·yā mə·’āh wə·‘eś·rîn dî le·hĕ·wōn bə·ḵāl mal·ḵū·ṯā
verses.literal: Now it pleased Darius to appoint 120 . . . . . . satraps - to rule throughout the kingdom
verses.literalPt: Foi do agrado de Dario constituir sobre o reino cento e vinte sátrapas, que estivessem por todo o reino;

verses.original: וְעֵ֤לָּא מִנְּהוֹן֙ סָרְכִ֣ין תְּלָתָ֔א דִּ֥י דָנִיֵּ֖אל חַֽד־ מִנְּה֑וֹן דִּֽי־ לֶהֱוֺ֞ן אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֗ין יָהֲבִ֤ין לְהוֹן֙ טַעְמָ֔א וּמַלְכָּ֖א לָֽא־ לֶהֱוֵ֥א נָזִֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘êl·lā min·nə·hō·wn sā·rə·ḵîn tə·lā·ṯā dî ḏā·nî·yêl ḥaḏ- min·nə·hō·wn dî- le·hĕ·wōn ’ă·ḥaš·dar·pə·nay·yā ’il·lên yā·hă·ḇîn lə·hō·wn ṭa‘·mā ū·mal·kā lā- le·hĕ·wê nā·ziq
verses.literal: and over them . . . three . . . administrators including Daniel . . . . . . . . . to whom these satraps . . . were accountable so that the king would not suffer loss
verses.literalPt: e, sobre eles, três presidentes, dos quais Daniel era um, a fim de que esses sátrapas lhes dessem conta e que o rei não sofresse dano.

verses.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ דָּנִיֵּ֣אל דְּנָ֔ה הֲוָ֣א מִתְנַצַּ֔ח עַל־ סָרְכַיָּ֖א וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֑א כָּל־ קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ יַתִּירָא֙ בֵּ֔הּ וּמַלְכָּ֣א עֲשִׁ֔ית לַהֲקָמוּתֵ֖הּ עַל־ כָּל־ מַלְכוּתָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin dā·nî·yêl də·nāh hă·wā miṯ·naṣ·ṣaḥ ‘al- sā·rə·ḵay·yā wa·’ă·ḥaš·dar·pə·nay·yā kāl- qo·ḇêl dî rū·aḥ yat·tî·rā bêh ū·mal·kā ‘ă·šîṯ la·hă·qā·mū·ṯêh ‘al- kāl- mal·ḵū·ṯā
verses.literal: Soon by . . . his extraordinary spirit Daniel . . . . . . distinguished himself among the administrators and satraps So the king planned to set him over the whole kingdom
verses.literalPt: Então, o mesmo Daniel sobrepujava a esses presidentes e aos sátrapas, porque nele havia um espírito excelente; e o rei pensava em o constituir sobre o reino todo.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן סָֽרְכַיָּ֜א וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּ֗א הֲו֨וֹ בָעַ֧יִן עִלָּ֛ה לְהַשְׁכָּחָ֥ה לְדָנִיֵּ֖אל מִצַּ֣ד מַלְכוּתָ֑א וְכָל־ עִלָּ֨ה וּשְׁחִיתָ֜ה לָא־ יָכְלִ֣ין לְהַשְׁכָּחָ֗ה כָּל־ קֳבֵל֙ דִּֽי־ מְהֵימַ֣ן ה֔וּא וְכָל־ שָׁלוּ֙ וּשְׁחִיתָ֔ה לָ֥א הִשְׁתְּכַ֖חַת עֲלֽוֹהִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin sā·rə·ḵay·yā wa·’ă·ḥaš·dar·pə·nay·yā hă·wōw ḇā·‘a·yin ‘il·lāh lə·haš·kā·ḥāh lə·ḏā·nî·yêl miṣ·ṣaḏ mal·ḵū·ṯā wə·ḵāl ‘il·lāh ū·šə·ḥî·ṯāh lā- yā·ḵə·lîn lə·haš·kā·ḥāh kāl- qo·ḇêl dî- mə·hê·man hū wə·ḵāl šā·lū ū·šə·ḥî·ṯāh lā hiš·tə·ḵa·ḥaṯ ‘ă·lō·w·hî
verses.literal: Thus the administrators and satraps sought . . . . . . a charge against Daniel concerning the kingdom but they could find no . . . charge or corruption because . . . he . . . was trustworthy and no negligence or corruption was found in him
verses.literalPt: Nisto os presidentes e os sátrapas procuravam ocasião contra Daniel quanto ao reino; porém não puderam achar ocasião ou culpa, porquanto ele era fiel, e não se achava nele nenhum erro nem culpa.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּ֤א אִלֵּךְ֙ אָֽמְרִ֔ין דִּ֣י לָ֧א נְהַשְׁכַּ֛ח לְדָנִיֵּ֥אל דְּנָ֖ה כָּל־ עִלָּ֑א לָהֵ֕ן הַשְׁכַּ֥חְנָֽה עֲל֖וֹהִי בְּדָ֥ת אֱלָהֵֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin guḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ ’ā·mə·rîn dî lā nə·haš·kaḥ lə·ḏā·nî·yêl də·nāh kāl- ‘il·lā lā·hên haš·kaḥ·nāh ‘ă·lō·w·hî bə·ḏāṯ ’ĕ·lā·hêh
verses.literal: Finally these men said . . . We will never find any charge against this Daniel unless we find something against him concerning the law of his God
verses.literalPt: Disseram, pois, esses homens: Não acharemos alguma ocasião contra este Daniel, se não o acharmos contra ele pelo que diz respeito à lei do seu Deus.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן סָרְכַיָּ֤א וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא֙ אִלֵּ֔ן הַרְגִּ֖שׁוּ עַל־ מַלְכָּ֑א וְכֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לֵ֔הּ דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א לְעָלְמִ֥ין חֱיִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin sā·rə·ḵay·yā wa·’ă·ḥaš·dar·pə·nay·yā ’il·lên har·gi·šū ‘al- mal·kā wə·ḵên ’ā·mə·rîn lêh dā·rə·yā·weš mal·kā lə·‘ā·lə·mîn ḥĕ·yî
verses.literal: So the administrators and satraps . . . went together to the king . . . and said O King Darius may you live forever
verses.literalPt: Então, os presidentes e sátrapas foram juntos ao rei e lhe disseram assim: Ó rei Dario, vive eternamente.

verses.original: אִתְיָעַ֜טוּ כֹּ֣ל׀ סָרְכֵ֣י מַלְכוּתָ֗א סִגְנַיָּ֤א וַֽאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא֙ הַדָּֽבְרַיָּ֣א וּפַחֲוָתָ֔א לְקַיָּמָ֤ה קְיָם֙ מַלְכָּ֔א וּלְתַקָּפָ֖ה אֱסָ֑ר דִּ֣י כָל־ דִּֽי־ יִבְעֵ֣ה בָ֠עוּ מִן־ כָּל־ אֱלָ֨הּ וֶֽאֱנָ֜שׁ עַד־ יוֹמִ֣ין תְּלָתִ֗ין לָהֵן֙ מִנָּ֣ךְ מַלְכָּ֔א יִתְרְמֵ֕א לְגֹ֖ב אַרְיָוָתָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’iṯ·yā·‘a·ṭū kōl sā·rə·ḵê mal·ḵū·ṯā siḡ·nay·yā wa·’ă·ḥaš·dar·pə·nay·yā had·dā·ḇə·ray·yā ū·p̄a·ḥă·wā·ṯā lə·qay·yā·māh qə·yām mal·kā ū·lə·ṯaq·qā·p̄āh ’ĕ·sār dî ḵāl dî- yiḇ·‘êh ḇā·‘ū min- kāl- ’ĕ·lāh we·’ĕ·nāš ‘aḏ- yō·w·mîn tə·lā·ṯîn lā·hên min·nāḵ mal·kā yiṯ·rə·mê lə·ḡōḇ ’ar·yā·wā·ṯā
verses.literal: All the royal administrators prefects satraps advisers and governors have agreed that the king should establish an ordinance and enforce a decree that for thirty days anyone who petitions . . . . . . any god or man except you . . . O king will be thrown into the den of lions
verses.literalPt: Todos os presidentes do rei, os deputados, os sátrapas, os conselheiros e os governadores, juntamente, tomaram conselho para estabelecer um estatuto real e fazer um interdito forte, que todo homem que, por espaço de trinta dias, fizer uma petição a qualquer deus ou a qualquer homem, exceto a ti, ó rei, será lançado na cova dos leões.

verses.original: כְּעַ֣ן מַלְכָּ֔א תְּקִ֥ים אֱסָרָ֖א וְתִרְשֻׁ֣ם כְּתָבָ֑א דִּ֣י לָ֧א לְהַשְׁנָיָ֛ה כְּדָת־ מָדַ֥י וּפָרַ֖ס דִּי־ לָ֥א תֶעְדֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kə·‘an mal·kā tə·qîm ’ĕ·sā·rā wə·ṯir·šum kə·ṯā·ḇā dî lā lə·haš·nā·yāh kə·ḏāṯ- mā·ḏay ū·p̄ā·ras dî- lā ṯe‘·dê
verses.literal: Therefore O king establish the decree and sign the document so that it cannot be changed in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians which cannot be repealed
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, ó rei, estabelece o interdito e assina a escritura, para que não se mude, conforme a lei dos medos e dos persas, que não se pode revogar.

verses.original: כָּל־ קֳבֵ֖ל דְּנָ֑ה מַלְכָּא֙ דָּֽרְיָ֔וֶשׁ רְשַׁ֥ם כְּתָבָ֖א וֶאֱסָרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- qo·ḇêl də·nāh mal·kā dā·rə·yā·weš rə·šam kə·ṯā·ḇā we·’ĕ·sā·rā
verses.literal: Therefore . . . . . . King Darius signed the written decree
verses.literalPt: Por isso, o rei Dario assinou a escritura e o interdito.

verses.original: וְ֠דָנִיֵּאל כְּדִ֨י יְדַ֜ע דִּֽי־ רְשִׁ֤ים כְּתָבָא֙ עַ֣ל לְבַיְתֵ֔הּ וְכַוִּ֨ין פְּתִיחָ֥ן לֵהּ֙ בְּעִלִּיתֵ֔הּ נֶ֖גֶד יְרוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְזִמְנִין֩ תְּלָתָ֨ה בְיוֹמָ֜א ה֣וּא׀ בָּרֵ֣ךְ עַל־ בִּרְכ֗וֹהִי וּמְצַלֵּ֤א וּמוֹדֵא֙ קֳדָ֣ם אֱלָהֵ֔הּ כָּל־ קֳבֵל֙ דִּֽי־ הֲוָ֣א עָבֵ֔ד מִן־ קַדְמַ֖ת דְּנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·nî·yêl kə·ḏî yə·ḏa‘ dî- rə·šîm kə·ṯā·ḇā ‘al lə·ḇay·ṯêh wə·ḵaw·wîn pə·ṯî·ḥān lêh bə·‘il·lî·ṯêh ne·ḡeḏ yə·rū·šə·lem wə·zim·nîn tə·lā·ṯāh ḇə·yō·w·mā hū bā·rêḵ ‘al- bir·ḵō·w·hî ū·mə·ṣal·lê ū·mō·w·ḏê qo·ḏām ’ĕ·lā·hêh kāl- qo·ḇêl dî- hă·wā ‘ā·ḇêḏ min- qaḏ·maṯ də·nāh
verses.literal: Now when Daniel learned that the document had been signed he went into his house where the windows of his upper room opened toward Jerusalem and three times a day he got down on his knees prayed and gave thanks to his God . . . just as . . . . . . he had done before . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando Daniel soube que a escritura estava assinada, entrou em sua casa (ora, na sua câmara estavam abertas as janelas que olhavam para Jerusalém); três vezes no dia, punha-se de joelhos, e orava, e rendia ações de graças diante de seu Deus, como antes costumava fazer.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּ֤א אִלֵּךְ֙ הַרְגִּ֔שׁוּ וְהַשְׁכַּ֖חוּ לְדָנִיֵּ֑אל בָּעֵ֥א וּמִתְחַנַּ֖ן קֳדָ֥ם אֱלָהֵֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin guḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ har·gi·šū wə·haš·ka·ḥū lə·ḏā·nî·yêl bā·‘ê ū·miṯ·ḥan·nan qo·ḏām ’ĕ·lā·hêh
verses.literal: Then these men went as a group and found Daniel petitioning and imploring . . . his God
verses.literalPt: Então, esses homens foram juntos e acharam a Daniel fazendo petições e súplicas diante de seu Deus.

verses.original: בֵּ֠אדַיִן קְרִ֨יבוּ וְאָמְרִ֥ין קֳדָם־ מַלְכָּא֮ עַל־ אֱסָ֣ר מַלְכָּא֒ הֲלָ֧א אֱסָ֣ר רְשַׁ֗מְתָּ דִּ֣י כָל־ אֱנָ֡שׁ דִּֽי־ יִבְעֵה֩ מִן־ כָּל־ אֱלָ֨הּ וֶֽאֱנָ֜שׁ עַד־ יוֹמִ֣ין תְּלָתִ֗ין לָהֵן֙ מִנָּ֣ךְ מַלְכָּ֔א יִתְרְמֵ֕א לְג֖וֹב אַרְיָותָ֑א עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜א וְאָמַ֗ר יַצִּיבָ֧א מִלְּתָ֛א כְּדָת־ מָדַ֥י וּפָרַ֖ס דִּי־ לָ֥א תֶעְדֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin qə·rî·ḇū wə·’ā·mə·rîn qo·ḏām- mal·kā ‘al- ’ĕ·sār mal·kā hă·lā ’ĕ·sār rə·šam·tā dî ḵāl ’ĕ·nāš dî- yiḇ·‘êh min- kāl- ’ĕ·lāh we·’ĕ·nāš ‘aḏ- yō·w·mîn tə·lā·ṯîn lā·hên min·nāḵ mal·kā yiṯ·rə·mê lə·ḡō·wḇ ’ar·yā·w·ṯā ‘ā·nêh mal·kā wə·’ā·mar yaṣ·ṣî·ḇā mil·lə·ṯā kə·ḏāṯ- mā·ḏay ū·p̄ā·ras dî- lā ṯe‘·dê
verses.literal: So they approached the king and asked . . . about his royal decree Did you not sign a decree that for thirty days any man who petitions . . . any god or man except you . . . O king will be thrown into the den of lions The king . . . replied According to the law of the Medes and Persians . . . the order stands and it cannot be repealed
verses.literalPt: Depois, chegando-se eles, falaram na presença do rei a respeito do interdito real: Não assinaste um interdito que, durante o espaço de trinta dias, todo homem que fizesse uma petição a qualquer deus ou a qualquer homem, exceto a ti, ó rei, fosse lançado na cova dos leões? Respondeu o rei e disse: Isso é a verdade, conforme a lei dos medos e dos persas, que não se pode revogar.

verses.original: בֵּ֠אדַיִן עֲנ֣וֹ וְאָמְרִין֮ קֳדָ֣ם מַלְכָּא֒ דִּ֣י דָנִיֵּ֡אל דִּי֩ מִן־ בְּנֵ֨י גָלוּתָ֜א דִּ֣י יְה֗וּד לָא־ שָׂ֨ם עֲלַיִךְ מַלְכָּא֙ טְעֵ֔ם וְעַל־ אֱסָרָ֖א דִּ֣י רְשַׁ֑מְתָּ וְזִמְנִ֤ין תְּלָתָה֙ בְּיוֹמָ֔א בָּעֵ֖א בָּעוּתֵֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin ‘ă·nōw wə·’ā·mə·rîn qo·ḏām mal·kā dî ḏā·nî·yêl dî min- bə·nê ḡā·lū·ṯā dî yə·hūḏ lā- śām ʿă·la·yiḵ mal·kā ṭə·‘êm wə·‘al- ’ĕ·sā·rā dî rə·šam·tā wə·zim·nîn tə·lā·ṯāh bə·yō·w·mā bā·‘ê bā·‘ū·ṯêh
verses.literal: Then they told . . . . . . the king Daniel one of the exiles . . . from Judah shows no regard for you O king or for the decree that you have signed He still makes his petition three times a day
verses.literalPt: Então, responderam e disseram diante do rei: Esse Daniel, que é um dos filhos do cativeiro de Judá, não faz caso de ti, ó rei, nem do interdito que assinaste, porém três vezes no dia faz as suas petições.

verses.original: אֱדַ֨יִן מַלְכָּ֜א כְּדִ֧י מִלְּתָ֣א שְׁמַ֗ע שַׂגִּיא֙ בְּאֵ֣שׁ עֲל֔וֹהִי וְעַ֧ל דָּנִיֵּ֛אל שָׂ֥ם בָּ֖ל לְשֵׁיזָבוּתֵ֑הּ וְעַד֙ מֶֽעָלֵ֣י שִׁמְשָׁ֔א הֲוָ֥א מִשְׁתַּדַּ֖ר לְהַצָּלוּתֵֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin mal·kā kə·ḏî mil·lə·ṯā šə·ma‘ śag·gî bə·’êš ‘ă·lō·w·hî wə·‘al dā·nî·yêl śām bāl lə·šê·zā·ḇū·ṯêh wə·‘aḏ me·‘ā·lê šim·šā hă·wā miš·tad·dar lə·haṣ·ṣā·lū·ṯêh
verses.literal: As soon as the king heard this he was deeply distressed . . . and set his mind on delivering Daniel and he labored until sundown . . . . . . to rescue him
verses.literalPt: Tendo, pois, o rei ouvido essas palavras, ficou muito contrariado e pensou em Daniel para o livrar; e até o pôr do sol trabalhou para o salvar.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ גֻּבְרַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֔ךְ הַרְגִּ֖שׁוּ עַל־ מַלְכָּ֑א וְאָמְרִ֣ין לְמַלְכָּ֗א דַּ֤ע מַלְכָּא֙ דִּֽי־ דָת֙ לְמָדַ֣י וּפָרַ֔ס דִּֽי־ כָל־ אֱסָ֥ר וּקְיָ֛ם דִּֽי־ מַלְכָּ֥א יְהָקֵ֖ים לָ֥א לְהַשְׁנָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin guḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ har·gi·šū ‘al- mal·kā wə·’ā·mə·rîn lə·mal·kā da‘ mal·kā dî- ḏāṯ lə·mā·ḏay ū·p̄ā·ras dî- ḵāl ’ĕ·sār ū·qə·yām dî- mal·kā yə·hā·qêm lā lə·haš·nā·yāh
verses.literal: Then the men approached . . . the king together and said to him Remember O king that by the law of the Medes and Persians . . . no decree or ordinance . . . established by the king can be changed
verses.literalPt: Então, esses homens foram juntos ao rei e lhe disseram: Sabe, ó rei, que é uma lei dos medos e dos persas que nenhum interdito nem estatuto, que o rei estabelecer, pode ser mudado.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֜יִן מַלְכָּ֣א אֲמַ֗ר וְהַיְתִיו֙ לְדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל וּרְמ֕וֹ לְגֻבָּ֖א דִּ֣י אַרְיָוָתָ֑א עָנֵ֤ה מַלְכָּא֙ וְאָמַ֣ר לְדָנִיֵּ֔אל אֱלָהָ֗ךְ דִּ֣י אַנְתָּה פָּֽלַֽח־ לֵהּ֙ בִּתְדִירָ֔א ה֖וּא יְשֵׁיזְבִנָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin mal·kā ’ă·mar wə·hay·ṯîw lə·ḏā·nî·yêl ū·rə·mōw lə·ḡub·bā dî ’ar·yā·wā·ṯā ‘ā·nêh mal·kā wə·’ā·mar lə·ḏā·nî·yêl ’ĕ·lā·hāḵ dî ʾan·tå̄h pā·laḥ- lêh biṯ·ḏî·rā hū yə·šê·zə·ḇin·nāḵ
verses.literal: So the king gave the order and they brought Daniel and threw him into the den of lions The king . . . said to Daniel May your God whom you serve continually . . . deliver you
verses.literalPt: Nisso passou o rei as ordens, e trouxeram a Daniel e lançaram-no na cova dos leões. Ora, falou o rei e disse a Daniel: O teu Deus, a quem continuamente serves, te livrará.

verses.original: וְהֵיתָ֙יִת֙ אֶ֣בֶן חֲדָ֔ה וְשֻׂמַ֖ת עַל־ פֻּ֣ם גֻּבָּ֑א וְחַתְמַ֨הּ מַלְכָּ֜א בְּעִזְקְתֵ֗הּ וּבְעִזְקָת֙ רַבְרְבָנ֔וֹהִי דִּ֛י לָא־ תִשְׁנֵ֥א צְב֖וּ בְּדָנִיֵּֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ṯā·yiṯ ’e·ḇen ḥă·ḏāh wə·śu·maṯ ‘al- pum gub·bā wə·ḥaṯ·mah mal·kā bə·‘iz·qə·ṯêh ū·ḇə·‘iz·qāṯ raḇ·rə·ḇā·nō·w·hî dî lā- ṯiš·nê ṣə·ḇū bə·ḏā·nî·yêl
verses.literal: A stone was brought and placed over the mouth of the den and the king sealed it with his own signet ring and with the rings of his nobles so that nothing . . . concerning Daniel could be changed
verses.literalPt: Uma pedra foi trazida e posta sobre a boca do covil; e o rei a selou com o seu anel e com o anel dos seus grandes, para que, no tocante a Daniel, nada se mudasse.

verses.original: אֱ֠דַיִן אֲזַ֨ל מַלְכָּ֤א לְהֵֽיכְלֵהּ֙ וּבָ֣ת טְוָ֔ת וְדַחֲוָ֖ן לָא־ הַנְעֵ֣ל קָֽדָמ֑וֹהִי וְשִׁנְתֵּ֖הּ נַדַּ֥ת עֲלֽוֹהִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin ’ă·zal mal·kā lə·hê·ḵə·lêh ū·ḇāṯ ṭə·wāṯ wə·ḏa·ḥă·wān lā- han·‘êl qā·ḏā·mō·w·hî wə·šin·têh nad·daṯ ‘ă·lō·w·hî
verses.literal: Then the king went to his palace and spent the night fasting No entertainment was brought before him and sleep fled from him
verses.literalPt: Depois, o rei se foi para o seu palácio e passou a noite em jejum; não foram trazidos à sua presença instrumentos de música, e fugiu dele o sono.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן מַלְכָּ֔א בִּשְׁפַּרְפָּרָ֖א יְק֣וּם בְּנָגְהָ֑א וּבְהִ֨תְבְּהָלָ֔ה לְגֻבָּ֥א דִֽי־ אַרְיָוָתָ֖א אֲזַֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin mal·kā biš·par·pā·rā yə·qūm bə·nā·ḡə·hā ū·ḇə·hiṯ·bə·hā·lāh lə·ḡub·bā ḏî- ’ar·yā·wā·ṯā ’ă·zal
verses.literal: At the first light of dawn the king got up and hurried . . . to the den of lions
verses.literalPt: Então, o rei se levantou pela manhã, muito cedo, e foi com pressa à cova dos leões.

verses.original: וּכְמִקְרְבֵ֣הּ לְגֻבָּ֔א לְדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל בְּקָ֥ל עֲצִ֖יב זְעִ֑ק עָנֵ֨ה מַלְכָּ֜א וְאָמַ֣ר לְדָנִיֵּ֗אל דָּֽנִיֵּאל֙ עֲבֵד֙ אֱלָהָ֣א חַיָּ֔א אֱלָהָ֗ךְ דִּ֣י אַנְתָּה פָּֽלַֽח־ לֵהּ֙ בִּתְדִירָ֔א הַיְכִ֥ל לְשֵׁיזָבוּתָ֖ךְ מִן־ אַרְיָוָתָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·miq·rə·ḇêh lə·ḡub·bā lə·ḏā·nî·yêl bə·qāl ‘ă·ṣîḇ zə·‘iq ‘ā·nêh mal·kā wə·’ā·mar lə·ḏā·nî·yêl dā·nî·yêl ‘ă·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·lā·hā ḥay·yā ’ĕ·lā·hāḵ dî ʾan·tå̄h pā·laḥ- lêh biṯ·ḏî·rā hay·ḵil lə·šê·zā·ḇū·ṯāḵ min- ’ar·yā·wā·ṯā
verses.literal: When he reached the den he cried out in a voice of anguish - O Daniel servant of the living God has your God whom you serve continually been able to deliver you from the lions
verses.literalPt: Chegando-se ele à cova, a Daniel, clamou com voz triste; falou o rei e disse a Daniel: Daniel, servo do Deus vivo, porventura, o teu Deus, a quem continuamente serves, pode livrar-te dos leões?

verses.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ דָּנִיֶּ֔אל עִם־ מַלְכָּ֖א מַלִּ֑ל מַלְכָּ֖א לְעָלְמִ֥ין חֱיִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin dā·nî·yel ‘im- mal·kā mal·lil mal·kā lə·‘ā·lə·mîn ḥĕ·yî
verses.literal: Then Daniel replied - O king may you live forever
verses.literalPt: Logo, disse Daniel ao rei: Ó rei, vive eternamente.

verses.original: אֱלָהִ֞י שְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאֲכֵ֗הּ וּֽסֲגַ֛ר פֻּ֥ם אַרְיָוָתָ֖א וְלָ֣א חַבְּל֑וּנִי כָּל־ קֳבֵ֗ל דִּ֤י קָֽדָמ֙וֹהִי֙ זָכוּ֙ הִשְׁתְּכַ֣חַת לִ֔י וְאַ֤ף קָדָמַיִךְ מַלְכָּ֔א חֲבוּלָ֖ה לָ֥א עַבְדֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lā·hî šə·laḥ mal·’ă·ḵêh ū·să·ḡar pum ’ar·yā·wā·ṯā wə·lā ḥab·bə·lū·nî kāl- qo·ḇêl dî qā·ḏā·mō·w·hî zā·ḵū hiš·tə·ḵa·ḥaṯ lî wə·’ap̄ qå̄·ḏå̄·ma·yiḵ mal·kā ḥă·ḇū·lāh lā ‘aḇ·ḏêṯ
verses.literal: My God sent His angel and shut the mouths of the lions They have not hurt me . . . for . . . I was found innocent in His sight and I have done no wrong against you O king
verses.literalPt: O meu Deus enviou o seu Anjo e fechou as bocas aos leões; eles não me fizeram mal algum, porque foi achada em mim inocência diante dele; também diante de ti, ó rei, não tenho cometido delito algum.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֣יִן מַלְכָּ֗א שַׂגִּיא֙ טְאֵ֣ב עֲל֔וֹהִי וּלְדָ֣נִיֵּ֔אל אֲמַ֖ר לְהַנְסָקָ֣ה מִן־ גֻּבָּ֑א וְהֻסַּ֨ק דָּנִיֵּ֜אל מִן־ גֻּבָּ֗א וְכָל־ חֲבָל֙ לָא־ הִשְׁתְּכַ֣ח בֵּ֔הּ דִּ֖י הֵימִ֥ן בֵּאלָהֵֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin mal·kā śag·gî ṭə·’êḇ ‘ă·lō·w·hî ū·lə·ḏā·nî·yêl ’ă·mar lə·han·sā·qāh min- gub·bā wə·hus·saq dā·nî·yêl min- gub·bā wə·ḵāl ḥă·ḇāl lā- hiš·tə·ḵaḥ bêh dî hê·min bê·lā·hêh
verses.literal: The king was overjoyed . . . . . . and gave orders to lift Daniel out of the den and when Daniel was lifted out of the den no wounds whatsoever were found on him because he had trusted in his God
verses.literalPt: Nisso se alegrou muito o rei e ordenou que tirassem da cova a Daniel. Assim foi Daniel tirado da cova, e não se achou nele lesão alguma, porque ele havia confiado em seu Deus.

verses.original: וַאֲמַ֣ר מַלְכָּ֗א וְהַיְתִ֞יו גֻּבְרַיָּ֤א אִלֵּךְ֙ דִּֽי־ אֲכַ֤לוּ קַרְצ֙וֹהִי֙ דִּ֣י דָֽנִיֵּ֔אל וּלְגֹ֤ב אַרְיָוָתָא֙ רְמ֔וֹ אִנּ֖וּן בְּנֵיה֣וֹן וּנְשֵׁיה֑וֹן וְלָֽא־ מְט֞וֹ לְאַרְעִ֣ית גֻּבָּ֗א עַ֠ד דִּֽי־ שְׁלִ֤טֽוּ בְהוֹן֙ אַרְיָ֣וָתָ֔א וְכָל־ גַּרְמֵיה֖וֹן הַדִּֽקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar mal·kā wə·hay·ṯîw guḇ·ray·yā ’il·lêḵ dî- ’ă·ḵa·lū qar·ṣō·w·hî dî ḏā·nî·yêl ū·lə·ḡōḇ ’ar·yā·wā·ṯā rə·mōw ’in·nūn bə·nê·hō·wn ū·nə·šê·hō·wn wə·lā- mə·ṭōw lə·’ar·‘îṯ gub·bā ‘aḏ dî- šə·li·ṭū ḇə·hō·wn ’ar·yā·wā·ṯā wə·ḵāl gar·mê·hō·wn had·di·qū
verses.literal: At the command of the king the men who had falsely accused . . . . . . Daniel were brought and thrown into the den of lions they and their children and wives And before they had reached the bottom of the den - the lions overpowered them and crushed all their bones
verses.literalPt: O rei deu ordens, e foram trazidos aqueles homens que tinham acusado a Daniel. Foram lançados na cova dos leões, eles, seus filhos e suas mulheres; e ainda não tinham chegado ao fundo da cova, quando os leões se apoderaram deles e lhes esmigalharam todos os ossos.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֜יִן דָּרְיָ֣וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗א כְּ֠תַב לְֽכָל־ עַֽמְמַיָּ֞א אֻמַיָּ֧א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֛א דִּֽי־ דָאֲרִין בְּכָל־ אַרְעָ֖א שְׁלָמְכ֥וֹן יִשְׂגֵּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin dā·rə·yā·weš mal·kā kə·ṯaḇ lə·ḵāl ‘am·may·yā ’u·may·yā wə·liš·šā·nay·yā dî- ḏå̄·ʾă·rīn bə·ḵāl ’ar·‘ā šə·lā·mə·ḵō·wn yiś·gê
verses.literal: Then King Darius wrote to the people of every nation and language throughout . . . the land May your prosperity abound
verses.literalPt: Então, o rei Dario escreveu a todos os povos, nações e línguas que habitam em toda a terra: Paz vos seja multiplicada!

verses.original: מִן־ קֳדָמַי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י׀ בְּכָל־ שָׁלְטָ֣ן מַלְכוּתִ֗י לֶהֱוֺ֤ן זָאֲעִין וְדָ֣חֲלִ֔ין מִן־ קֳדָ֖ם אֱלָהֵ֣הּ דִּי־ דָֽנִיֵּ֑אל דִּי־ ה֣וּא׀ אֱלָהָ֣א חַיָּ֗א וְקַיָּם֙ לְעָ֣לְמִ֔ין וּמַלְכוּתֵהּ֙ דִּֽי־ לָ֣א תִתְחַבַּ֔ל וְשָׁלְטָנֵ֖הּ עַד־ סוֹפָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: min- qo·ḏā·may śîm ṭə·‘êm dî bə·ḵāl šā·lə·ṭān mal·ḵū·ṯî le·hĕ·wōn zå̄·ʾă·ʿīn wə·ḏā·ḥă·lîn min- qo·ḏām ’ĕ·lā·hêh dî- ḏā·nî·yêl dî- hū ’ĕ·lā·hā ḥay·yā wə·qay·yām lə·‘ā·lə·mîn ū·mal·ḵū·ṯêh dî- lā ṯiṯ·ḥab·bal wə·šā·lə·ṭā·nêh ‘aḏ- sō·w·p̄ā
verses.literal: I hereby decree that in every part of my kingdom men are to tremble in fear . . . before the God of Daniel For He is the living God and He endures forever . . . His kingdom . . . will never be destroyed and His dominion . . . will never end
verses.literalPt: Faço um decreto que em todo o domínio do meu reino, tremam os homens e temam diante do Deus de Daniel, pois ele é o Deus vivo e que permanece para sempre; o seu reino é o que não será destruído, e o seu domínio durará até o fim.

verses.original: מְשֵׁיזִ֣ב וּמַצִּ֗ל וְעָבֵד֙ אָתִ֣ין וְתִמְהִ֔ין בִּשְׁמַיָּ֖א וּבְאַרְעָ֑א דִּ֚י שֵׁיזִ֣יב לְדָֽנִיֵּ֔אל מִן־ יַ֖ד אַרְיָוָתָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: mə·šê·ziḇ ū·maṣ·ṣil wə·‘ā·ḇêḏ ’ā·ṯîn wə·ṯim·hîn biš·may·yā ū·ḇə·’ar·‘ā dî šê·zîḇ lə·ḏā·nî·yêl min- yaḏ ’ar·yā·wā·ṯā
verses.literal: He delivers and rescues He performs signs and wonders in the heavens and on the earth for He has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions
verses.literalPt: Ele livra, e salva, e faz milagres e maravilhas no céu e na terra; foi ele quem livrou a Daniel do poder dos leões.

verses.original: וְדָנִיֵּ֣אל דְּנָ֔ה הַצְלַ֖ח בְּמַלְכ֣וּת דָּרְיָ֑וֶשׁ וּבְמַלְכ֖וּת כּ֥וֹרֶשׁ פָּרְסָיָא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·nî·yêl də·nāh haṣ·laḥ bə·mal·ḵūṯ dā·rə·yā·weš ū·ḇə·mal·ḵūṯ kō·w·reš på̄·rə·så̄·yå̄
verses.literal: So Daniel . . . prospered during the reign of Darius and the reign of Cyrus the Persian
verses.literalPt: Daniel, pois, prosperava no reinado de Dario e no reinado de Ciro, o persa.
